content:
anita: Heads-up — planning a pre-merge migration + backfill during the 02:00–02:30 UTC quiet window tomorrow. wanted a short go/no-go thread. 

deploybot: @channel scheduled window reserved: 2024-03-15 02:00 UTC -> 02:30 UTC. target job: tenant_metadata_backfill_v3. Runbook link: https://go/internal/runbooks/tenant-backfill-v3 :white_check_mark:

sam: quick Q — will this take any exclusive locks on tenant_profile table? last time we got a 30s spike.

kevin: it does a short index-creation step in middle that takes SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE for the index swap. we have TTL gating and rate caps. plan is to chunk at 5k rows/min.

maria: telemetry: I've added a dashboard for token_count and row-lag + an alert at >2min median. sna trigger will alert eng-oncall.

anita: ops checklist: 1) pin service to commit sha: release/2024-03-14-tenant-backfill 2) prod feature flag off for migration-mode 3) canary on 10% tenants 4) rollback playbook in hand.

josh: can we reduce canary size to 3%? last time 10% hit an auth-edge case.

kevin: fine with 3%. update jobs to sample tenant shards 0-2 only.

deploybot: deploybot: canary rollout configured: 3% -> 100% over 10 minutes unless error threshold tripped. will pause at 3% and wait for manual unpause.

sam: rollback trigger suggestion: if index build holds >120s or write errors >0.5% for 2 minutes, abort backfill and mark rollout failed.

maria: logging: added structured log keys: backfill.phase, backfill.chunk_id, errors.count. will export to bigquery for fast slice queries.

ops-bot: preflight checks passed: DB replicas healthy, schema-migrations-test: ok, disk headroom >20% across primary azs.

anita: release notes snippet (internal): "Tenant metadata backfill v3 — safer chunking, index swap with minimal lock, canary rollout." public notes TBD after rollout.

kevin: pin request: ops please pin migration-runner image to sha256:abc123... before we unpause.

deploybot: pinned image sha256:abc123... to migration-runner in canary group.

sam: small nit — ensure deploybot has the escape-hatch flag set so we can abort without partial index leftover.

ops-bot: escape-hatch: index-swap rollback implemented: will attempt to drop temp index if incomplete; otherwise alert DB-owners.

maria: I'll run a small synthetic canary on staging now to sanity-check metrics - report back in 20m.

anita: timeline: staging sanity -> ops-bot preflight -> code pin -> deploybot schedule -> manual unpause at 01:50 UTC if all green. go/no-go decision at 01:50.

josh: i'm +1 for proceed if staging sanities look good.

kevin: +1 from infra side, will be standing by for rollback.

sam: +1 but will watch locks.

deploybot: reminder: when you post the manual unpause, include the thread link and a short reason. I will annotate the deploy with that message id.

anita: ok — will post go/no-go at 01:50. if anyone sees anything odd ping me directly. :pray: 

maria: staging sanity: passed. no error spikes, median chunk time 12s.

ops-bot: final preflight: maintenance window confirmed, pager duty assigned to eng-oncall (Sam).

anita: GO at 01:50 UTC — unpausing canary.

deploybot: canary unpaused. rollout at 3% now. will report progress.

deploybot: canary progress: 3% complete, no errors, median chunk 14s.

maria: metrics look stable. no increased db contends.

deploybot: canary progressed to 30% after automated ramp, paused for manual inspection.

kevin: doing manual index-swap watch. everything is within thresholds.

anita: decision: continue to 100%. keep an eye on row-lag.

deploybot: rollout completed to 100%. final status: success. total runtime: 22m.

sam: confirmed no exclusive lock incidents. nice work.

maria: pulling final perf dump for postmortem and release notes. will send summary.

anita: postmortem: trivial — no rollback needed. leaving this thread open for a bit in case of delayed fallout. thanks all. :tada:
